I will keep this plot the simple way I know. I own this land, so I will put manure if I can gather enough, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer because cash is tight and on this small piece I do not want that risk. I will plant the cassava cuttings I trust, I will weed by hand with family, and if grass gets too much I may call a few people for help.
